items.title: Pay overdue 2027 membership fee plus dunning fee
items.quote: Wir bitten Sie, den Rückstand bis einschließlich 4. Juni 2027 auf das unten genannte Vereinskonto zu überweisen.
items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar date for payment: 'bis einschließlich 4. Juni 2027' (by and including 4 June 2027). This is a fixed date set by a private association (not a statutory deadline from a German authority), so no deemed-delivery rule or §187/188 BGB counting applies — the date is simply the last day payment must arrive. No weekend/holiday shift is stated or required by law for a private creditor's payment request; the due date is taken as printed.

warnings: This is a private sports club's payment reminder (Mahnung), not an official authority letter, so it carries no Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung and no statutory deemed-delivery rules; the payment date is simply the date printed.

The IBAN (DE32 3705 0198 0006 0189 80) is well-formed and belongs to a German bank, but this only confirms the IBAN's format — verify the account and payee name (e.g. against a prior invoice or the club's known bank details) before transferring, especially since a returned direct debit and added fees are common phishing/scam pretexts.
